explanation: The statement is `IsOpen (regularDomain P h)` where `regularDomain` is the library's own definition, the intersection of `D.carrier`, `{p | 0 < p.1}`, `{p | 0 < P.f p}`, `{p | 0 < shearA P p}` and `{p | L h p.2 ≠ 0}`. It is an openness result for an intersection of several preimages of open sets under specific continuous functions, proved by `isOpen_iff_mem_nhds` plus continuity of `P.f`, `shearA`, and `NaturalAxisData.L h ·`. No Mathlib declaration states anything about `regularDomain` (grep for `regularDomain` in Mathlib finds nothing), and the only relevant Mathlib lemmas are the generic building blocks `isOpen_iff_mem_nhds`, `isOpen_lt`, `IsOpen.inter`, `IsOpen.preimage`/`isOpen_ne.preimage`, all of which would have to be combined with the definition unfolded and with continuity side conditions (smoothness of `P.f` and `shearA`, polynomial continuity of `L h`), which is not a one- or two-line instantiation of a single Mathlib declaration. Hence no duplicate or special case was found.
